title: Magna theme manifest (theme.json)
description: The manifest of a Magna theme or theme addon. Read by Magna core (ThemeManifest) and Magna Pages. Unknown keys are ignored.

name.description: Package name in vendor/name form. Lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '_'; exactly one slash. The theme is installed at themes/<vendor>/<name>/.

displayName.description: Shown on the Themes page. Defaults to name.

description.description: One or two sentences shown on the Themes page.

version.description: Semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). Update checks compare it.

screenshot.description: Path, relative to the theme folder, of the image shown on the Themes page (1200×900 PNG or JPEG recommended).

type.description: A full theme, or an addon that styles a paired plugin's blocks inside a host theme.

magna.description: Composer-style constraint on the Magna core version, e.g. "^1.6.2". Defaults to "^1.0". Checked on activation.

plugins.description: Plugin versions this theme's rendering needs, as package name → constraint. Activation is refused (with a message naming the gap) when a floor is not met. Declare magna-cms/pages.

demoContent.description: Site-kit bundles imported by "Include demo content" / "Import demo content". Only .json files inside starter/. Without this key every starter/*.json counts.

blockSeeds.description: What a freshly inserted block starts with, per block handle, merged over the block schema's own seed.

extends.description: Addon only: the host theme name, or "*" for any theme.

pairsWith.description: Addon only: the plugins whose blocks this addon may restyle. Core blocks can never be overridden by an addon.

priority.description: Addon only: tie-break between addons (higher wins).
